newsitem.title: UK: British champion hurdler saved in suspected arson attack.
newsitem.headline: British champion hurdler saved in suspected arson attack.

text.p: Britain's champion hurdler Collier Bay was saved but four other racehorses died in a suspected arson attack on trainer Jim Old's stable on Monday, firefighters said.
They took an hour to bring the blaze under control as Old battled to save his 40-horse string of valuable racehorses at his Marlborough Downs stable.
"A few more minutes and it would have been a total disaster. The smoke would have killed the horses," Old said.
Two horses were killed in the fire in an indoor riding barn, two others died from injuries as they tried to escape.
One of the last to be led to safety was Collier Bay, which propelled Old to stardom last March when by landing the Champion Hurdle at Cheltenham.
A fire service spokesman told the London Times: "We are treating the fire as being of doubtful origin."
